map.零件质量与重心估算工具计算单一零件质量，并对多零件组合估算合成重心位置，适合结构: The part mass and center-of-gravity estimator computes a single part's mass and estimates the combined center of gravity for multi-part assemblies, suitable for structural design, counterweight and balance analysis.
map.单零件质量计算，多零件组合重心估算: Single part mass calculation, multi-part combined center-of-gravity estimation
map.多零件组合重心 Xc=Σmi·xi/Σmi。: Multi-part combined center of gravity Xc = sum(mi*xi)/sum(mi).
map.不规则截面形心（数值积分/分解法）。: Centroid of irregular section (numerical integration / decomposition).
map.校验重心相对支承的位置（防倾覆）。: Verify center of gravity relative to support position (anti-overturn).
map.：件1 质量 10 kg、xc=20 mm；件2 质量 5 kg、xc=80 m: : part1 mass 10 kg, xc=20 mm; part2 mass 5 kg, xc=80 mm: Xc=(10x20+5x80)/(10+5)=(200+400)/15=40 mm. Center of gravity is closer to the heavier part.
map.：Zc=Σmi·zi/Σmi，逐轴独立计算；若 Zc 超出支承包络则倾覆风险。: : Zc=sum(mi*zi)/sum(mi), computed independently per axis; if Zc exceeds the support envelope there is overturn risk.
map.滚动轴承额定寿命L10估算: Rolling bearing rated life L10 estimation
map.重心和形心一样吗？: Is center of gravity the same as centroid?
map.均质时重心=形心（几何中心）；非均质需用质量加权，不能简单用几何。: When homogeneous, center of gravity = centroid (geometric center); non-homogeneous needs mass weighting, not simple geometry.
map.为什么算重心？: Why compute the center of gravity?
map.旋转件需动平衡、运输件需防倾覆、吊装件需定吊点，重心是这些设计的基础。: Rotating parts need dynamic balancing, transport parts need anti-overturn, lifting parts need defined lift points; center of gravity is the basis of these designs.
